subtitle: Full theory-based breakdowns showing how all musical elements work together to create compelling songs.

introduction.title: Understanding Complete Musical Works
introduction.text: Complete song analysis brings together all aspects of music theory to understand how a song functions as a unified artistic statement. We examine harmonic progressions, melodic development, rhythmic patterns, formal structure, and arrangement choices to reveal the musical logic behind memorable songs.

columns.title: Theory Integration
columns.text: See how harmony, melody, rhythm, and form work together.

columns.title: Deep Analysis
columns.text: Examine every musical decision and its compositional impact.

columns.title: Practical Application
columns.text: Apply insights to your own playing and songwriting.

cards.title: Prerequisites
items: Basic Music Theory: Scales, intervals, chord construction
Roman Numeral Analysis: Understanding chord functions and progressions
Song Form Knowledge: Common song structures and section functions

cards.title: Next Steps
items: Start with Simple Songs: Begin with straightforward progressions and forms
Focus on One Element: Analyze harmony first, then add melody and rhythm
Apply to Your Playing: Use insights to improve your own musical expression

cards.title: Active Listening
items: Listen to songs multiple times focusing on different elements
Identify chord changes by ear before looking up tabs
Notice how sections transition and connect
Pay attention to instrumental arrangements and interactions

cards.title: Written Analysis
items: Create chord charts with Roman numeral analysis
Map out complete song forms and structures
Note interesting harmonic or melodic choices
Compare similar songs to find common patterns
